title: Wall Mounted Soap Dish, 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Antique Copper | Brass Soap Dishes | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bar soap off the countertop and maintain a clean sink area with a wall mounted soap dish designed for everyday bathroom use in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms.

  • Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Coordinate your space: Part of the Brass Soap Dishes collection for a cohesive accessory look.
  • Fits transitional style: A distinctive design that pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.

Specs
Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 3 x 3.5 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 in.
Shipping weight: 2 lbs
Assembly: Assembled in the U.S.A.
